base_prompt:
A high-end stylised 3D animated feature film, cinematic and colourful, family comedy-adventure tone, expressive cartoon character animation with squash-and-stretch, detailed fur and fabric, soft global illumination, rich saturated colour, shallow depth of field, anamorphic widescreen framing, smooth professional camera work.
Setting: a cavernous chamber so comprehensively grey that even the shadows are grey, with a reinforced steel cage at its centre. Lighting: cold flat grey light, a single spotlight on the cage.
In the shot: the Grumpy Glitch-Bots, boxy grey rectangular robots shaped like small filing cabinets on stubby metal legs, each with a small speaker grille for a mouth, a single blinking red sensor eye, and a chest panel covered in rows of grey buttons; they move stiffly in rigid formation; the Big Glitch-Bot, a towering grey filing-cabinet robot twice the size of the others, with a single large red sensor eye and one big square button in the centre of its chest.
Camera: Wide, Bots advancing in formation.
Action: Seventeen regrouped Glitch-Bots march out of the far wall in perfect formation, holding out forms and clipboards, stamping in unison as they advance on the heroes.
Dialogue: The Big Glitch-Bot (deep, flat, booming monotone robotic voice, bit-crushed, utterly without joy, booming monotone) says: "FORMS MUST BE COMPLETED IN TRIPLICATE."
Sound effects: stomping in unison, paper rustle, stamping, ambience of low hum, squirrel chittering echoing.
Audio: dialogue and sound effects only, no background music, no narrator other than the characters speaking. No subtitles, no captions, no readable on-screen text.
negative_prompt: live action, photorealistic humans, 2D flat animation, anime, sketch, subtitles, captions, on-screen text, watermark, logo, distorted faces, extra limbs, extra fingers, flicker, background music
